title: Longest prefix match
hints: `mask = prefix == 0 ? 0 : 0xFFFFFFFFu << (32 - prefix)`: shifting a 32-bit value by 32 is undefined, so /0 needs its own case (lesson 1.05).
Read `a.b.c.d` with an `std::istringstream` and `char` for the dots.
requirements: Parse addresses into `std::uint32_t` and routes into (network, prefix length, gateway).
A route matches when `(address & mask) == network`; the longest prefix wins.
Refuse a route whose network has bits set outside its mask.
stretch: Store the routes in a binary trie keyed by bits, the way real routers do.
